sets.relationshipLabel: a shipboard thing and a feature it simply has
sets.explanation: A vessel has an anchor and a cabin has a porthole — each pair names a whole and a part it always possesses.

sets.relationshipLabel: a thing and the made image that depicts it
sets.explanation: A shipwreck is captured in a diorama and a captain is captured in a portrait — each first item is rendered as the second.

sets.relationshipLabel: a museum worker and the thing their work is about
sets.explanation: A curator's work centers on the exhibit and a conservator's on the artifact — each professional is defined by the object they tend.

sets.relationshipLabel: the same kind of vessel or inlet, smaller then larger
sets.explanation: A skiff scaled up becomes a galleon, and a cove scaled up becomes a bay — each pair names the same category of thing at two ends of a size scale.
